notes.eight-fold-khatam: The plain design: eight-pointed stars packed close, with cross arms, eight-sided pieces, small squares and shields between them.
notes.agra-fort-band-rows: The same five pieces, with the stars set out in rows and bands between the rows.
notes.golestan-palace-star-rows: The same five pieces, with the stars in rows joined by connecting tiles.
notes.bahramiye-mosque-stars: The same five pieces, with each star in a ring of interlaced bands.

title: Stars and connectors of the Charbagh madrasa

notes.charbagh-stars: The khatam’s five pieces and one more, a long ten-sided connector, with the stars set in a square grid.
notes.iranian-star-columns: The same six pieces in the same amounts as Charbagh, with the stars set in upright columns.
notes.qom-atiq-courtyard-rows: The same six pieces, with more stars and fewer eight-sided pieces, set in rows.

title: Eight-pointed stars, crosses and pentagons

notes.fatehpur-sikri-stars: Three pieces only, eight-pointed stars, crosses and pentagons, with the stars in a square grid.
notes.isfahan-royal-mosque-star-rows: The same three pieces, with the stars in rows and the crosses in columns between them.
notes.topkapi-scroll-pinwheel: The same three pieces, turning round each star like a pinwheel.

title: Stars, crosses and squares of Khojent and Mosul

notes.khojent-tile-stars: Eight-pointed stars, ten-sided crosses, squares and pentagons, with the squares gathered into large crosses.
notes.mosul-imam-yahya-star-rows: The same four pieces, with the stars in rows and one square between each four stars.

title: Octagons of Bourgoin plates 144 and 52

notes.bourgoin-144-octagon-bands: Eight-pointed stars and octagons joined by long bands, laid in a square grid.
notes.bourgoin-52-octagon-rows: The same five pieces in nearly the same amounts, laid in rows instead.

title: Ten-pointed stars of Çamlıca and the Imamzadeh Ismail

notes.camlica-mosque-stars: Ten-pointed stars with pentagons and six-sided pieces, in a pattern mirrored only one way.
notes.isfahan-imamzadeh-ismail-stars: The same seven pieces, with the stars closer together and more of the small ones round them.
